steps.description: Load nation, find SAUDI ARABIA nationkey, scan supplier to build SA suppkey bitset
Parallel scan lineitem: filter l_suppkey IN sa_suppkey_bitset AND l_receiptdate > l_commitdate. Collect compact array of (l_orderkey, l_suppkey) pairs.
For each candidate pair, use orders_o_orderkey_lookup to get order row_id, check o_orderstatus == 'F'. Filter in-place or compact.

For each surviving candidate (l_orderkey, l_suppkey), use lineitem_l_orderkey_grouped to get all lineitems for the order. Single pass per order: check EXISTS (any lineitem with different suppkey) and NOT EXISTS (no lineitem with different suppkey that is also late).
steps.notes: For each order's lineitems: set exists=false, not_exists_violated=false. For each lineitem with different suppkey: exists=true. If also late: not_exists_violated=true, break early. Pass if exists && !not_exists_violated.

steps.description: Count by suppkey using direct array indexed by suppkey (max 100K). Then map suppkey to s_name for output.
Partial sort / top-100 by (numwait DESC, s_name ASC)

join_order.notes: Single nationkey → bitset of ~4000 supplier suppkeys
Bitset indexed by suppkey for O(1) lookup during lineitem scan
Use orders_o_orderkey_lookup dense_pk_array for O(1) order status check
Use lineitem_l_orderkey_grouped to get all lineitems per order. Combined EXISTS + NOT EXISTS check in single pass.

filters.predicate: l_suppkey IN sa_bitset AND l_receiptdate > l_commitdate

data_structures.sa_suppkey_bitset: bitset(100001) — indexed by suppkey, marks SA suppliers
data_structures.candidate_pairs: compact_array<struct{int32_t orderkey, int32_t suppkey}> — two-pass parallel scatter, sized to actual qualifying count
data_structures.count_by_suppkey: direct_array<int32_t>(100001) — indexed by suppkey, aggregation counts. Suppkey domain is small (100K) so full-keyspace is acceptable here

parallel_phases.description: Pass 1: each thread counts qualifying rows in its morsel. Prefix sum. Pass 2: scatter (orderkey, suppkey) pairs at computed offsets.
Partition candidate_pairs across threads. Each thread checks order status and EXISTS/NOT EXISTS independently. Aggregate into shared count_by_suppkey array using atomic increments.

indexes.purpose: O(1) order row_id lookup for status check
Get all lineitems per order for EXISTS/NOT EXISTS checks

aggregation.notes: Suppkey domain is bounded (0..99999), direct array is optimal. Atomic increments for thread safety.

output.materialization: late — resolve s_name from suppkey only for groups with nonzero count, then top-100 via partial_sort

mmap_advice.lineitem_columns: MADV_SEQUENTIAL + MADV_HUGEPAGE — sequential scan of l_suppkey, l_orderkey, l_receiptdate, l_commitdate
mmap_advice.orders_o_orderstatus: MADV_RANDOM — random access via index lookup
mmap_advice.raii_scoping: Declare MMap objects at outer scope before RAII timer to exclude munmap TLB shootdown cost

optimization_notes.compact_arrays: Use two-pass parallel scatter for candidate_pairs — never use full-keyspace arrays for intermediate results
optimization_notes.combined_exists_check: EXISTS and NOT EXISTS share the same lineitem_l_orderkey_grouped lookup — do both checks in single pass per order with early termination
optimization_notes.early_termination: In NOT EXISTS check: if any other-supplier lineitem is late, break immediately (anti-join violated)
optimization_notes.demand_paged_mmap: No MAP_POPULATE — demand-page all column files
